what_happened: Job 20261029-181835-9vvy ("Refuse readings that drop or defer a part the request names") failed in planning, before any code was written. This is the re-ask of job 20261029-111202-2bpc, which failed in planning on the same goal. In round 3 of 3 the plan still needed revising. This time Athena's own mechanical plan check found the problem and the critic was not called. The one finding was a major: Criterion 4 has two demonstrations, and the plan format allows exactly one per criterion. No acceptance criteria were reported unmet and no repo checks failed. Nothing was delivered.
cause: The planner is told the plan's shape only in prose, and Athena's structural check (one demonstration per criterion) is not shown to it as a rule. It is also not run as a cheap gate on every draft with its result fed back. A format defect can therefore appear or remain in any round, including the last. Planning has a fixed three rounds and keeps no partial plan, so a trivially fixable mechanical defect fails the whole job, and the money spent on earlier rounds is lost. The job carries more risk because it is a retry that already used planning budget on a plan with many criteria and demonstrations to track.
prevention: Run the plan's structural validation (demonstration count per criterion, and any other format rules) on every draft immediately after the planner writes it, before the critic. Return the exact findings to the planner as a mandatory fix, so format defects are repaired within the round. Add a final repair pass for mechanical-only findings: if the last round ends with only structural findings, give the planner one cheap fix-only attempt, or merge or trim the extra demonstrations in code, rather than failing the job. Also state the rule in the planner brief.
proposed_request: Make the planning stage repair mechanical plan-format defects instead of failing the job on them. Outcome: when a plan draft breaks a structural rule that Athena checks by code, such as a criterion having two demonstrations when exactly one is required, the planner gets the exact finding and fixes it before the critic is called. This must also hold in the last round. If only mechanical findings remain after the last round, one fix-only attempt runs before the job fails. Acceptance: (1) A test with a plan draft that gives one criterion two demonstrations shows the structural finding is returned to the planner in the same round, before any critic call. (2) A test with a draft that is clean except for that defect in round 3 of 3 shows a fix-only pass runs and the job proceeds to the producer once it is fixed. (3) A test shows a plan with a substantive critic finding in the last round still fails planning as before. (4) The planner brief states the one-demonstration-per-criterion rule and stays within its token budget. (5) The changelog entry is added as the defaults require, and the text uses no banned words.
